run_confusion_matrix_cli: run the confusion matrix tool from segmentation results using config, prediction path, and save directory
calculate_confusion_matrix: calculate a confusion matrix by comparing ground truth labels against segmentation prediction results
plot_confusion_matrix: plot a normalized confusion matrix heatmap with class labels, colorbar, and percentage values
parse_args: parse command line arguments for config file, prediction path, save directory, show flag, and color theme
main: load predictions from images, build dataset, calculate confusion matrix, and plot the results
